narrative.overview: Real product screenshots carry the portfolio. Warm paper, near-black ink, and forest green frame the work. Oversized headings and fine rules organize concise engineering descriptions in both languages.
keyCharacteristics: Real product interfaces in their source direction.
Arabic RTL and English LTR layouts with equivalent hierarchy.
Quiet surfaces, with depth reserved for overlapping screenshots.
dos: Do keep project artwork sourced from the product itself.
Do use logical CSS properties so both languages share the same layout.
Do respect reduced motion for smooth scrolling, screenshot lifts, and button presses.
